The sphere indenter pushes into the substrate at a constant velocity of 0.25 /ps.
the γ phase block is 67 × 30× 67 αγ
the γ′ phase block is 66× 30× 66 αγ′
the void, as a defect in the substrate, anchors the expansion of dislocation lines in the substrate and an abundance of dislocation lines pile up on the surface of the void.
the surface of the void is a stress concentration area and alleviates the stress inside the substrate due to the indentation, thus weakening the power of dislocation propagation.
with the increase in void radius, the dislocation density ρ in the substrate decreases gradually.
the preset void in the substrate can severely weaken the fitted Young’s modulus, and Young’s modulus values decrease gradually with the void radius increase.
